hook: His boat sank. Then his life raft started filling up.
narration: His fishing boat sank off Admiralty Island, Alaska, and the life raft he escaped into started taking on water.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Air Station Sitka flew to him, about two miles east of Murder Cove.
In a hoist like this, the pilots cannot see straight down. The flight mechanic in the open door talks them into position, foot by foot.
The same crew member runs the cable, lowering help and lifting people back up into the cabin.
outcome: The Sitka aircrew hoisted the boater up and aboard the Jayhawk.
title: His Boat Sank, Then His Life Raft Started Flooding
description:
A fishing vessel sank near Murder Cove on Admiralty Island, Alaska, and the boater's life raft began taking on water. A Coast Guard Air Station Sitka MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew hoisted him to safety on Sept. 28, 2026.
